page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d3s.12xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs utilizing Intel Xeon 8369B processors operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The system is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

A defining characteristic of this instance is its storage configuration, which bundles 286044 GB of local HDD storage. Network performance is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 60 Gbps. The instance does not include any graphics processing units and provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The primary tradeoff of the ecs.d3s.12xlarge is the reliance on HDD storage, which offers massive capacity but lower input/output operations per second compared to solid-state alternatives. This design makes the instance qualitatively cost-effective for high-density bulk storage and sequential data processing rather than random-access databases. Appropriate workloads include big data analytics, MapReduce jobs, large-scale log processing, and distributed file systems.
